_doc: Per-pair rulings on the CULTURAL tokens in references/_tradition_signatures.json, read by scripts/check_signature_tokens.js. A token is cultural when references/_soundword_vocab.json classes it so: it claims a tradition belongs to, descends from, or is shaped by a specific culture, people, place, language, religion or rite, or a named cultural tradition. Every (tradition, cultural token) pair on a real tradition id carries a ruling here, and a pair with no ruling BLOCKS the gate, so a new cultural claim cannot land unread. Each pair is ruled against the tradition's OWN catalog prose (name, lineage and description as published in api/browse.json, i.e. references/05_traditions.js lineage + references/06_extras.js description, plus its exemplars, parent tree node and crossRefs), never outside knowledge. Truth is a property of the PAIR: one token can be attested on one tradition and false on another, so a token is never deleted wholesale. Verdicts: 'attested' - the prose names or plainly entails the culture or lineage; 'loose' - an umbrella, ancestral or diaspora link the prose supports, kept; 'false' - deleted from the signature table and so from the src/app.js mirror, codex.html, the atlas and the connector, and the gate fails if it comes back. Style tokens (genre and idiom words, Western art-music periods, generic function words, species-only materials) are classed in the vocabulary but not ruled here.
_fields: tradition: a tradition id. token: the signature token exactly as written. verdict: attested | loose | false. tier (false only): core - no documented link; contradicted - the prose distinguishes or excludes it, and the evidence quotes that prose verbatim; boundary - a neighbouring culture or lineage the prose does not claim. evidence: the prose the ruling rests on - verbatim quotes, and for core and boundary the fields read and why none links. flag (optional): a reading the owner may want to revisit; it never changes the verdict - iberian-celtic-compound-reading (the token is read as its gloss states, Iberian + Celtic, e.g. Galicia/Asturias, so one half alone does not attest it), gospel-rooted-black-church-reading (attested as Southern Protestant gospel; false under a strict Black-church-descent reading), gospel-rooted-direction (kept on the Black-church umbrella though gospel proper is the record's descendant), prose-silent-world-plausible (false on this record's prose though plausible from outside knowledge; the fix, if wanted, is to say so in the prose).
